growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the income statements; the cause of the increase is not given.
growth_thesis.claim: Sales and mine operating income grew strongly. The 2026 nine-month sales were 954,319 against 676,818 a year earlier (table in thousands of US dollars), and mine operating income was 531,872 against 318,501. Full-year 2025 sales were 947,059 against 677,243 in 2024. For this to continue, realised prices and volumes must hold at or above the 2026 level. The packet does not say what drove the increase.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated by the CEO in the 2 November 2026 release; the conditions are inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Management names the 30% plant expansion at Séguéla as a growth driver. The CEO says it and Diamba Sud together underpin a target of approximately 60% growth in annual gold production to an annualized rate of 500,000 ounces from mid-2028. For this to hold, the expansion must be built and commissioned on the July final investment decision and the 2028 timing, and it must perform at the expanded rate.
quotes: Together, these projects underpin our target of approximately 60% growth in annual gold production to an annualized rate of 500,000 ounces from mid-2028.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 2 November 2026 release; the conditions are inferred from its milestone table.
growth_thesis.claim: The Diamba Sud gold project in Senegal is a second driver, and permitting is the near-term condition. The Ministry issued a Notice of Admissibility on November 2, 2026, and the company expects the internal government approval of the final Exploitation Permit during the fourth quarter of 2026. Its schedule then shows FID in Q4 2026 and first gold pour in Q2/Q3 2028. For this to continue, the permit must be granted, FID taken, and construction and procurement kept on the milestones.
quotes: marking an important final step toward the granting of the Exploitation Permit

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 2 November 2026 release; the conditions are inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Exploration at the newly acquired Bambadji Project, near Diamba Sud, is a possible extension driver. Early Kabewest drilling returned 1.9 g/t Au over an estimated true width of 64 meters in hole FBRC0008. The company plans an initial Inferred Mineral Resource estimate in the first quarter of 2027. For this to matter, the remaining assays must confirm the interpretation and a resource must be published and then converted into mine plans.
quotes: work toward an initial Inferred Mineral Resource estimate, planned for publication in the first quarter of 2027

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the 40-F statements; the funding link is inferred.

Net cash from continuing operating activities was 455,366, against additions to mineral properties and property, plant and equipment of 178,004. Debt was 134,410. For this to continue, operating cash flow must keep covering capital spending as the two projects are built.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the income statement; the interpretation is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Rising taxes cut how much of the growth reaches net income, so tax levels are a condition. Nine-month 2026 income taxes were 175,398 against 73,858, and net income from continuing operations was 255,988 against 214,789. Q3 net income from continuing operations fell to 52,295 from 128,200. The Q3 2025 figure included a 52,745 impairment reversal. For earnings to keep growing with sales, tax and cost pressure must not absorb the gains.
